The '''Dyarchy Fleet''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] that served the [[Dyarchy]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] principality that ruled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byllura]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. Construction of the fleet commenced in about [[1037 BBY]], under the orders of the Dyarchy's [[Krevaaki]] [[Regent/Legends|regent]], [[Saaj Calician]], and the [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] were built in secret beneath the reflecting pools of Byllura's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], [[Hestobyll]]. By [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], 14 vessels in the fleet were battle-ready, and the ships were placed under the command of several [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Celegian/Legends|Celegians]], who could receive [[Telepathy/Legends|telepathic]] commands from Calician, granting the Krevaaki full control over the vessels. After [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Daiman]], the leader of the rival [[Daimanate]] state, committed the bulk of his military to [[Invasion of the Bactranate|the invasion]] of [[Bactranate|the holdings]] of the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ayanos Bactra]], Calician ordered to Dyarchy Fleet to mobilize and planned to have it conquer the undefended, outlying Daimanite worlds. However, the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] caused the shutdown of the telepathic communications network through which Calician controlled Byllura, which led a series of manufacturing accidents that destroyed the bulk of the Dyarchy Fleet. The few ships that had been able to launch were destroyed moments later, after the Dyarchy fell [[Battle of Byllura|under attack]] from the forces of the [[Arkadianate]].
